name: 62712 · Springfield, IL
findings: ZIP 62712 (Springfield) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62712 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62712 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
